question: What topics arise in the application of the paths in chapter ten?
premises: Contemplation of non-difference, trembling, and laughter are treated.
These occur in the application of the paths.
The increase in number and nature of impurities and the variety of power are treated.
inference: Chapter 10 connects experiential signs of non-difference with doctrines of impurity and power.
uncertainties: kampa and hāsa may refer to spontaneous yogic manifestations.
plain_english: In the application of the paths, contemplation of non-difference, trembling, and laughter are treated, along with the increased enumeration and nature of the impurities and the variety of power.
